title: Saturn Music School 2
native_title: サターンミュージックスクール２
overview:
You'll come to love playing on your own!

Your piano skills improve rapidly while you play as if it were a game!! Using the Sega Saturn and a commercially available MIDI keyboard, you can practice piano and keyboard and do desktop music! The lessons are made up of cool songs from Sakura Wars, Virtua Fighter, Daytona USA, and more!! The Famous Songs Album includes 20 songs such as TV drama theme songs and songs by X Japan and Le Couple! It will properly score your playing! On top of that, you can even make your own original songs with the sequencer!!

Included songs:
- Itoshi no Ellie
- Can You Celebrate
- Saboten no Hana
- However
- Dare yori Suki na no ni
- Hidamari no Uta
- Forever Love
- Let It Be
- Jackson's Cornery
- Rydeen
- Princess Mononoke
- Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind
- Nazo
- Revolution
- You Get to Burning
- Electrical Parade
- Senna no Piano 2
- Gymnopedie
- Nocturne
- Moonlight

自分で弾くことスキになる!

ピアノの腕前がゲーム感覚で遊んでいるうちにどんどん上達する!!セガサターンと市販のMIDIキーボードを使用して、ピアノ、キーボードの練習やDTMができる!レッスンの中では、さくら大戦、バーチャファイター、デイトナUSAなどのクールな曲で構成!!名曲アルバムでは、ドラマの主題歌やX-JAPAN、ル・クプル等の曲を20曲収録!あなたの腕前にちゃ~んと点数つけてあげるよ!その他にシーケンサーを使ってオリジナルの曲もつくれちゃう!!
